events.title: Get a Cocktail at Teddy’s Tavern
Teddy Roosevelt at the Menger Hotel, San Antonio, Texas
events.description:
Join us at the historic Menger Hotel in San Antonio, Texas, and experience the legendary Theodore Roosevelt come to life in an unforgettable show!

Joe Wiegand, the world’s premiere Theodore Roosevelt reprisor, will share stories of his time in San Antonio recruiting Rough Riders, his path to the White House, and how the West shaped his conservation legacy. Before the main show, get into the Americana mood with music by folk artist Tom Brosseau and Queen of the West, Emily Walter. Enjoy a delicious meal by the Menger Hotel’s chefs and take in the rich history of the hotel – a place that has hosted countless influential figures throughout the years, including Teddy himself! Whether you’re a history enthusiast or a lover of live music, join us in celebrating the legacy of one of America’s most beloved presidents through entertainment and delicious eats.

Tickets do not include a stay at the Menger Hotel.

events.title: Beat the Winter Blues
events.description:
Get out of the cold and join us for a fun-filled day indoors at the West River Community Center! You and your family can enjoy a variety of exciting activities all day long, including inflatables, music, crafts, pool party, golfing and so much more!

As your admission, simply bring a non-perishable food item to donate to the Amen food pantry. Plus, you’ll have the chance to win door prizes throughout the day!

\*POOL CLOSURE – The aquatic areas \(leisure, lap, sauna, hot tub\) will be closed from 10:00 am-12:00 pm in preparation for the pool party.

WRCC MEMBERSHIP SPECIAL!

Purchase a 3-month or annual membership \(paid in full\) and get a 10% discount. Discount good day of event only.

THANK YOU TO OUR SPONSORS!

events.title: Get a Cocktail at Teddy’s Tavern
Girlfriend Getaway 2027
events.description:
About the Girlfriend Getaway

The Girlfriend Getaway was created from a simple belief: women need spaces where they can reconnect with themselves and with each other.

So many of us spend our days caring for everyone else. Managing it all. Showing up for everyone around us. Somewhere along the way, it gets easy to lose touch with ourselves.

This is now our fourth year gathering, and every time, the same thing happens. Women who don’t know a single soul in the room leave feeling like they’ve found their people.

Three days at the Rough Rider Hotel in Medora, ND. Speakers who share real stories, not polished performances. Small group conversations. Time built in just for you: a massage, a facial, reiki, whatever kind of care your body and heart are asking for. And plenty of open space too, to wander Medora, find a coffee shop, read a book, breathe.

You don’t have to come with a plan. You don’t have to come with friends. You just have to come as you are.

If this is your first time, welcome. You’re exactly where you’re meant to be. If you are returning, we can’t wait to see you again.

Ready to grab your spot? Tickets and all the details are linked above. And be sure to tap Going or Interested so you don’t miss updates as we get closer, we’ll be sharing more in the Discussion tab along the way.

events.title: Double Dinks: Dink, Laugh, Repeat
events.description:
Get ready for Double Dinks: Dink, Laugh, Repeat, a fun, social, and inclusive pickleball mini tournament designed for players of all skill levels! This doubles event features fixed partners, with teams consisting of any combination of pairings. Teams will be placed into divisions based on their combined player rating, ensuring balanced and competitive matchups. The tournament will follow a pool play \(round robin\) format, where each team faces every other team in their division once.

Players are encouraged to bring energy and creativity to the court. Prizes will be awarded for Top Team, Bottom Team, and Best Dressed Team.

AGES: 8\+

FEE: $10

DEADLINE: January 28

REGISTER ONLINE
